model_basis: Current user config.toml model and effort read on 2026-09-05; stated before execution. Not inherited from another Plan's override.
renderer: Bundled Playwright with local Google Chrome, Windows Arial and Georgia; actual versions and font hashes recorded by freeze
evaluator: Coordinating agent; artifact-first under neutral IDs, not independent or fully arm-blind; source and trace checked afterwards. No population-level or causal model-performance claim.
exposure: Core and concern-selected owner texts supplied inline, same selection both arms. No auto-discovery/routing or tool-read proof is claimed. No source web pages or other case outputs supplied.
parity: Baseline precedes candidate for each paired case. Same prompt, schema, settings, renderer, content, fonts and output contract. Preserve every outcome, including valid poor artifacts. Countercases are requested in the same call and scored separately.
p2_late_comparison: Keep original candidate-only observation if a later comparison becomes necessary. Freeze a separately justified new comparison revision, baseline before candidate; no unchanged-result fishing.
artifact_contract: Return complete editable main.html plus control.html when requested, with inline SVG/CSS/JS only and no remote dependencies, using Arial or Georgia as appropriate. Do not use tools or read other files: all authorized task and Skill content is supplied inline. Host materializes and renders the returned source. Never create a file for a critique-only task. State evidence limits truthfully; do not claim host renders were already inspected.
